name: Cherry Bomb: Chou-ojou-sama Sayaka-chan Nanpa Daisakusen
original_name: チェリーボム 超お嬢さま沙也香ちゃんナンパ大作戦
source:
Young girl Sayaka has transfers to main character's class. She is the only daughter of a powerful corporation and a returnee from France. Protagonist tries to conquer her heart, but is stopped all the time by the girl bodyguards. At such time he finds a mysterious gem. When he touches it, a voice is heard from nowhere...

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/07/vn-of-month-april-1994.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
少女沙耶香转学到主角的班级。她是大企业的独生女，也是法国海归。主角试图征服她的心，却始终被女保镖阻止。就在这时，他发现了一颗神秘的宝石。当他触碰它时，不知从哪里传来了声音……

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/07/vn-of-month-april-1994.html]vndbreview[/url]]
